name: Content Saver & Forwarder Bot
description: High-performance Telegram bot for managing, saving, and forwarding content with full forum topic support.

DEVICE_MODEL.description: Device name shown in Telegram Active Sessions (Settings > Devices)

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram user ID(s) of bot owner(s), space separated (e.g. 12345678 87654321)

STRING.description: Optional Telethon/Pyrogram premium session string for 4GB upload support

FORCE_SUB.description: Channel ID (with -100 prefix) for mandatory join. Set 0 to disable.

LOG_GROUP.description: Channel or Group ID (with -100 prefix) for administrative logs. Set 0 to disable.

MASTER_KEY.description: Master key for AES session encryption (32 characters)

IV_KEY.description: IV key for AES session encryption (16 characters)

FREEMIUM_LIMIT.description: Batch processing limit for free users (0 for unlimited/default handling)

PREMIUM_LIMIT.description: Batch processing limit for premium users

ADMIN_CONTACT.description: Telegram contact link for support (e.g. https://t.me/YourSupport)

JOIN_LINK.description: Public invite link for your updates channel
